summary: Acceptance passes at HEAD d987d079. All six acceptance criteria hold, and every task except the deferred closeout task T5 is complete. The combined suite (86 tests), the doctor, the facts check, and prettier exit 0. Two live renders through the pinned venv exit 0, and their decoded audio equals the seven committed files. Every open finding is nonblocking. The most important one is two type errors in tests/sound-set.test.ts.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] phase-acceptance: tests/sound-set.test.ts:333 and tests/sound-set.test.ts:335 add two TypeScript errors, TS2532 and TS18048, to the repo typecheck. Under noUncheckedIndexedAccess, bytes[5] and count can be undefined. Both lines come from Red commit 8a5582cc. The repo baseline is 38 error lines in 13 files (measure/tech-debt.md TD-35 to TD-39), so tsc --noEmit now reports 40 lines in 14 files. No spec, plan, or strategy gate of this track runs tsc, so every declared gate stays green. Fix: write (bytes[5] ?? 0) & 0x02 and bytes[26] ?? 0. Do not use the ! operator. The adversarial test runs this function body through new Function, which accepts JavaScript only. A test-only commit keeps the prerequisite results valid. If the owner declines the fix, record the two errors in measure/tech-debt.md. Rationale: the typecheck was already red before this phase, so this finding stays nonblocking.

F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The renderer output is not byte-reproducible, and this matters for the closeout gate. Two fresh renders differ from each other and from the committed files by 23 to 32 bytes per file. The differing fields are the Ogg stream serial and the page CRC. The decoded audio is identical for all seven files. test-strategy.md:149-150 runs the wrapper in the real root, and the wrapper first removes each target (scripts/sound-set.mjs:93). That run rewrites the seven committed files and shows seven binary changes in git status. Closeout should run that gate with SOUNDS_ROOT set to a scratch root, as this acceptance did, and keep the committed files unchanged. The strategy also asks for that run after every remediation commit (test-strategy.md:144). green-r3.log, green-r4.log, and green-r5.log did not run it. This acceptance ran it at the audited HEAD, so the gap is historical.

F3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Plan and spec text drift for the closeout owner. (1) plan.md:76 and plan.md:82 name Case 9 for the committed-files case. The stale-output case became case 9 (plan.md:67), so the committed-files case is case 10 (plan.md:72). (2) The touched-files list at plan.md:9-20 omits tests/sound-set.adversarial.test.ts. (3) spec.md:80-82 says the wrapper forwards the output of a successful call. The rule that child stderr goes to the wrapper stdout appears only in plan.md:31-35 and test-strategy.md:42-47, and tests/sound-set.test.ts:101-109 enforces it. Rationale: the drift is text only, and no behavior differs.

F4 [Nit] phase-acceptance (carried from review-a F5): plan.md:165 marks T5 with [ ] and the owner text deferred:closeout-steward. countPlanTasks at measure/tools/common.mjs:113 counts only the [ ], [~], and [x] markers, so a [b] marker would not count. The doctor needs one unchecked task while the track is in_progress. The closeout role should flip T5, set the status to completed in metadata.json and measure/tracks.md, regenerate the facts, and archive the track in one step.

F5 [Nit] phase-acceptance (carried from review-b F1 and F2): D4 pins only the earshot commit. pip freeze lists unpinned transitive packages: numpy 2.4.6, numba 0.68.1, scipy 1.17.1, soundfile 0.14.0, soxr 1.1.0, cffi 2.1.1, and llvmlite 0.50.0. scripts/sound-setup.sh:11 runs rm -rf .venv-earshot before each interpreter attempt. Plan T3 asks the builder to record deferred work in the owning track, but measure/tech-debt.md and the track audio_game_integration_20261014 hold no earshot entry. Closeout should record both notes as debt, or state that none is needed.

F6 [Nit] phase-acceptance: measure/gates.json holds only GENERATED_CHECK_COMMAND. The orchestrator supplied the PROJECT_* values, RED_TEST_COMMAND, and GREEN_TEST_COMMAND for each run, with track-scoped values: lint is prettier on the sound files and tests, checks is node measure/tools/generate.mjs --check, and tests is the combined suite. The repo gate file holds no value for tsc. This is framework state and does not block this phase.
